title: 智能体记忆是数据库吗？重新思考长期AI智能体记忆的数据基础
summary: 本文提出长期AI智能体记忆应被视为一种新的数据管理工作负载，其正确性取决于状态轨迹而非单个记录。作者形式化了受控演化记忆（GEM），用四个状态级操作符替代记录级数据库操作，并定义了六个正确性条件。通过原型MemState验证了可行性，并指出了构建原生引擎的研究方向。
summary_en: This paper proposes that long-term AI agent memory should be treated as a new data-management workload, where correctness is a property of the state trajectory, not individual records. It formalizes Governed Evolving Memory (GEM) with four state-level operators and six correctness conditions, validates feasibility via MemState prototype, and outlines research directions for memory-centric data management.
